categories.name: أَسْمَاءُ اللهِ الْحُسْنَى عَلَى وَزْنِ فَعِيلٍ
categories.nameEn: Beautiful Names of Allah on the pattern Fa'eel

items.verse: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لَا يُؤْمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
items.verseEn: Indeed, he did not used to believe in Allāh, the Most Great,

items.verse: ۞ وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَجَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌۭ كَرِيمٌ
items.verseEn: And We had already tried before them the people of Pharaoh, and there came to them a noble messenger [i.e., Moses],
And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

items.verse: وَيُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ
items.verseEn: And Allāh makes clear to you the verses [i.e., His rulings], and Allāh is Knowing and Wise.

categories.name: مُفْرَدَاتٌ مِنْ قِصَّةِ مَرْيَمَ فِي سُورَةِ مَرْيَمَ
categories.nameEn: Key terms from the story of Maryam in Surah Maryam

items.verse: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مَرْيَمَ إِذِ ٱنتَبَذَتْ مِنْ أَهْلِهَا مَكَانًۭا شَرْقِيًّۭا
items.verseEn: And mention, [O Muḥammad], in the Book [the story of] Mary, when she withdrew from her family to a place toward the east.

items.verse: قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ رَسُولُ رَبِّكِ لِأَهَبَ لَكِ غُلَـٰمًۭا زَكِيًّۭا
items.verseEn: He said, "I am only the messenger of your Lord to give you [news of] a pure boy [i.e., son]."

items.verse: قَالَتْ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى غُلَـٰمٌۭ وَلَمْ يَمْسَسْنِى بَشَرٌۭ وَلَمْ أَكُ بَغِيًّۭا
items.verseEn: She said, "How can I have a boy while no man has touched me and I have not been unchaste?"

items.verse: وَبَرًّۢا بِوَٰلِدَتِى وَلَمْ يَجْعَلْنِى جَبَّارًۭا شَقِيًّۭا
items.verseEn: And [made me] dutiful to my mother, and He has not made me a wretched tyrant.

categories.name: أَوْصَافُ الْحُورِ الْعِينِ فِي الْقُرْآنِ
categories.nameEn: Descriptions of the Houris in the Quran

items.verse: فِيهِنَّ قَـٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرْفِ لَمْ يَطْمِثْهُنَّ إِنسٌۭ قَبْلَهُمْ وَلَا جَآنٌّۭ
items.verseEn: In them are women limiting [their] glances, untouched before them by man or jinnī -
In them are good and beautiful women -
And with them will be women limiting [their] glances, with large, [beautiful] eyes,
And with them will be women limiting [their] glances and of equal age.

categories.name: أَوَامِرُ الْجَمْعِ فِي سُورَةِ الْبَقَرَةِ
categories.nameEn: Plural Imperative Commands in Surah Al-Baqarah

items.verse: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ رَبَّكُمُ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُمْ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَّقُونَ
items.verseEn: O mankind, worship your Lord, who created you and those before you, that you may become righteous -

items.verse: يَـٰبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ ٱذْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَتِىَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنْعَمْتُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَأَوْفُوا۟ بِعَهْدِىٓ أُوفِ بِعَهْدِكُمْ وَإِيَّـٰىَ فَٱرْهَبُونِ
items.verseEn: O Children of Israel, remember My favor which I have bestowed upon you and fulfill My covenant [upon you] that I will fulfill your covenant [from Me], and be afraid of [only] Me.

items.verse: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ ءَامِنُوا۟ بِمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ قَالُوا۟ نُؤْمِنُ بِمَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيْنَا وَيَكْفُرُونَ بِمَا وَرَآءَهُۥ وَهُوَ ٱلْحَقُّ مُصَدِّقًۭا لِّمَا مَعَهُمْ ۗ قُلْ فَلِمَ تَقْتُلُونَ أَنۢبِيَآءَ ٱللَّهِ مِن قَبْلُ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
items.verseEn: And when it is said to them, "Believe in what Allāh has revealed," they say, "We believe [only] in what was revealed to us." And they disbelieve in what came after it, while it is the truth confirming that which is with them. Say, "Then why did you kill the prophets of Allāh before, if you are [indeed] believers?"

items.verse: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ يَوْمًۭا لَّا تَجْزِى نَفْسٌ عَن نَّفْسٍۢ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا يُقْبَلُ مِنْهَا عَدْلٌۭ وَلَا تَنفَعُهَا شَفَـٰعَةٌۭ وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
items.verseEn: And fear a Day when no soul will suffice for another soul at all, and no compensation will be accepted from it, nor will any intercession benefit it, nor will they be aided.

harf.hint: Rely upon Allah; put your trust in Him (imperative form)
harf.arabicVerse: وَلِلَّهِ غَيْبُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ يُرْجَعُ ٱلْأَمْرُ كُلُّهُۥ فَٱعْبُدْهُ وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَيْهِ ۚ وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِغَـٰفِلٍ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
harf.verse: 11:123 - And to Allāh belong the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and the earth and to Him will be returned the matter, all of it, so worship Him and rely upon Him. And your Lord is not unaware of that which you do.

deduction.title: Spoken Into Being
deduction.intro: A figure emerges from sacred history, carrying miracles that defied the natural order. This soul arrived through a single divine command, defended a parent from grave accusations, and departed this world before earthly chains could bind them. The story spans from a humble cradle to the heavens above. Who could this be?
clues: I was sent as a sign and mercy from Allah to the Children of Israel.
My arrival was unlike any before — I came into being by the divine word 'Be!' without an earthly father.
My parent faced cruel slander, but sacred revelation descended to declare their innocence and elevate their station.
As a newborn infant, I astonished those around me by speaking clearly from my cradle to clear my parent's name.
By Allah's permission, I shaped life from lifeless clay, gave sight to the blind, and cured the leper with my touch.
I was raised up to the heavens before harm could touch me, and I shall return to this world before the final Hour arrives.

Prophet Dawud

options: Speaking from the cradle as an infant
Surviving in the belly of a great fish
Being cast into a blazing fire
Building a great ark before a flood
Facing the sorcery of Pharaoh's court

Led the Children of Israel out of Egypt

Survived a massive flood with the faithful
Built the sacred house in Mecca
outcome.answer: Raised to the heavens, will return before the Day of Judgment

deduction.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱبْنَ مَرْيَمَ وَأُمَّهُۥٓ ءَايَةًۭ وَءَاوَيْنَـٰهُمَآ إِلَىٰ رَبْوَةٍۢ ذَاتِ قَرَارٍۢ وَمَعِينٍۢ
deduction.verse: And We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign and sheltered them within a high ground having level [areas] and flowing water. (23:50)

translations: His slaves and restricts for him
scramble.hint: A comforting reminder that Allah never burdens a soul beyond what it can bear — each person is accountable for their own deeds.
scramble.arabic: ٱللَّهُ يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ وَيَقْدِرُ لَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌۭ
scramble.verseEn: Allāh extends provision for whom He wills of His servants and restricts for him. Indeed Allāh is, of all things, Knowing.
